summary: Ernesto Rodolfo Hintze Ribeiro (1849–1907) led the Regenerator Party and was President of the Council of Ministers of Portugal three times under the constitutional monarchy: from 1893 to 1897, from 1900 to 1904 and again in 1906. He is in the atlas as the holder of those three turns at the headship of the government.
